records.company_overview: Postman is the leading collaboration platform for API-development, used by more than 40 million users and 500,000 companies worldwide. Postman simplifies each step of the API lifecycle and streamlines collaboration so you can create better APIs—faster.
records.target_audience: Engineers, API teams, and enterprises building, testing, and managing APIs at scale.

records.company_overview: Supabase is an open-source platform that provides a Postgres database with built-in authentication, real-time capabilities, and serverless functions. It offers a suite of tools and services that enable developers to build, scale, and deploy applications quickly without managing infrastructure.
records.target_audience: Developers, startups, and SaaS companies looking for a scalable, open-source backend solution.

records.company_overview: Vapi is a unified platform that enables enterprises to build, test, and deploy voice agents at scale. It provides orchestration, real-time monitoring, and enterprise‑grade configurability with sub‑500ms latency.
records.target_audience: Enterprises and Fortune 100 companies seeking scalable, secure voice agent solutions.
